verdict.rationale: Caveman ships as an installable skill and CLI for coding agents, so install scope is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing between project-local, repo-committed installation and user-global installation. The mentions of the CLI, the skill and plugins do not address install scope.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects
